multi_shot.semantics: Once hidden or explicit multi-shot complexity is proven in locked dynamic sources, source normalization becomes mandatory and cannot be disabled later.

principles: Runtime context is derived from SLOT_MANIFEST plus an immutable ordered context-event chain.
Manual CURRENT_STATE context edits are invalid.
A context change cannot relax a previously required gate.
multi_shot is monotonic false-to-true because the purpose is to reveal extra normalization requirements, not remove them.
